headline: S&P 500 Rises To 7,655.27 From 7,622.78 As The Daily Loss Narrows To 0.11 Percent
narrative: The S&P 500 rose to 7,655.27 from 7,622.78, and the daily loss narrowed to 0.11 percent from 0.53 percent. The S&P pipe is the cash index of large U.S. stocks, so the higher print means equity cash value rose against the prior reading and the day's decline shrank. The VIX fell to 19.36 from 19.97, and the Nasdaq rose to 26,069.89 from 25,983.99.
author: jordan
